title: Validate diagnostics document (validate-json)
description:
The structured diagnostics document of `rfs validate --json` -
the shape editor integrations consume (Phase 5 task 13). File mode prints
ONE object for the input file (`ok: true` with an empty `errors` array on
success); directory mode prints an array of one object per FAILING file -
valid files are omitted entirely, so an all-valid directory prints `[]`.
Exit codes mirror the text path: 0 when nothing failed, 1 otherwise. The
root is a union of the two shapes (draft-07 anyOf over the same
`validate_file` definition). A `.json` input that is not valid IR JSON
produces a CLI-level stderr error in file mode (no document) but appears as
a `kind: "semantic"` entry (line/col 0) in directory mode.

file.description: the input path as passed on the command line (file mode) or the collected file path (directory mode)

errors.description: structured diagnostics; empty when ok (file mode prints the object even on success)

kind.description: "parse" = RFS source rejected by the parser (line/col are the 1-based error position); "semantic" = parsed IR rejected by the validator, or a .json input that is not valid IR JSON in directory mode (no span: line/col are 0)

line.description: 1-based error line; 0 when unknown (semantic errors carry no span)

message.description: the diagnostic text (same wording as the stderr report)
